old: mode := track value.token s.mode, urls := annotate value.token s.urls
new: mode := s.mode, urls := annotate value.token s.urls
witness: theorem counterexample : seen (fresh (fun _ => ⟨.function [118],⟨1,none⟩⟩) true {constructor ⟨none,none⟩ with mode:=.looking [[118]]}).mode=false := rfl

old: def hit (c : Cache) (s : State) : State := { s with cursor := c.value.cursor }
new: def hit (c : Cache) (s : State) : State := { s with cursor := c.value.cursor, mode:=track c.value.token s.mode }
